headline: TWICE's Jeongyeon makes film debut as a military nurse
sub: Director says he's "150% satisfied" with her acting
source: Source: KT Studio Genie, via Korean media
caption:
TWICE's Jeongyeon is heading to the big screen! 🎬

New stills show her as nurse officer Yoo Jeong Yeon, a character who shares her name, in the horror-comedy 'New Recruit: The Movie' (Korean subtitle: 'A Ghost Lives in the Military Hospital'). It's her first film role, and director Min Jin Ki said he is "150% satisfied" with her performance. The film opens in theaters Dec 30.

📌 Source: KT Studio Genie, via Korean media (Star News, Newsen)
